title: jensen-plugin-manifest
description: The manifest.json of a Jensen plugin, apiVersion 1. Written by `jensen-plugin build` from the `jensen` block of package.json. Mirrors backend::plugins::domain::manifest::Manifest and is enforced by backend::plugins::domain::validate. Panes, commands, hotkeys, settings, menus, status items and themes are registered at runtime from main.js, so there is no contributes block.

id.description: Reverse-dns identifier, lowercase letters/digits with '.' or '-' separators (e.g. dev.jensen.gcp-scanner).

version.description: Semantic version (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH). Must equal the GitHub release tag.

apiVersion.description: The plugin protocol this plugin speaks, see schema/plugin-api.v1.json. A manifest without it was built for the retired plugin system and is refused.

dist.description: Added at release time by `jensen publish`. Pins each shipped asset to a sha256 so the manifest checksum transitively pins the whole release. The runtime ignores it.

main.description: The single bundle, relative to the plugin directory. It runs headless for logic and again inside a sandboxed frame for custom panes.

permissions.description: Capabilities the plugin asks for. The effective grant is what is declared and the user approved.

workspace.description: Open, close, move and observe panes.

theme.description: Switch the active theme and register themes.

settings.description: Read and write Jensen's own settings.

editor.description: Editor access: read the buffer and selection, or also edit it.

fs.description: Project relative directories the plugin may use.

network.description: Hosts the plugin may fetch over https.
